text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho declares her intention to cast her magic on the whole world at the Takarazuka Kinen. Hearing this, Zenno Rob Roy makes a decision of her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hopes to win the Senior Autumn Triple Crown, become Umamusume of the Year, and then—as the representative of the Triple Crown tour—slay the witch at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the last thing Sweep Tosho needs to complete her racing magic—a special rival—has presented itself.
